column1: COACHEASILY — WHAT AI CALLING ADDED  (CBA X · English)
17 Jul – 14 Aug 2026 · English L0 workshop (11 AM) · base = registrants · connected = talk > 15s · baseline = not connected · team numbers deleted
REVENUE WITH AI CALLING vs WITHOUT

Method: 'with AI' = all 111 CBA X buyers among the window's registrants × ₹6,999. 'without AI' = that minus the extra AI created (connected leads 1,248 × the +3.90 pt buy-lift = 48.6 sales). ROI = AI added ÷ Signup+Day-of talk-cost (₹23,230). Base = 2,624 registrants (team deleted); connected = Signup/Day-of English bots held a conversation longer than 15s; baseline = the 1,376 registrants the bots never held a conversation with (never dialled, or dialled and not picked up). Full detail, per-bot and per-day, on the 'CBA X report' tab.
